description: The reference history starting 2023-02-01: the Half-yearly and Yearly series are too short, the Weekly has 53 of 55 candles.
explanation: Missing higher-timeframe data is never 'no conflict': without a Half-yearly series the conflict check cannot be done, so G5 is DATA_INSUFFICIENT (spec 7.4), and the 55-candle SMA trend (RB 1748) has only 53 Weekly candles, so G4 is MANUAL. DATA_INSUFFICIENT outranks MANUAL in the status order (spec 8).
title: History too short for Half-yearly: G5 DATA_INSUFFICIENT
